subject: Hospitality
title: Plant-Based Menus in Hotels
description: A quick win: understand Plant-Based Menus in Hotels.

hook.text: Hilton reported a 250% increase in plant-based orders from 2019 to 2022. Hotels ignoring the trend leave revenue on the table.

buildup.text: Plant-based options attract vegans, flexitarians, health-conscious travelers, and guests with religious dietary requirements.

discovery.text: Plant-Based Menus in Hotels reveals the mechanism or argument that changes the picture.

twist.text: Simply adding a sad salad as the 'vegan option' backfires. Guests want creative, satisfying plant dishes—not an afterthought.

climax.text: Hotels with dedicated plant-based menus report higher F&B satisfaction scores across ALL guests—not just plant-based eaters.

punchline.text: 250% growth, lower costs, higher satisfaction. Plant-based menus are the smartest F&B.
